about.missing: This first version has no Vietnamese meanings yet and only level A1. Level A1 currently has 539 of the 1164 CEFR-J words: each uses only its most common meaning with an example sentence containing the word. The rest, mostly words with no open example yet (such as apple, egg) and function words (such as a, the, in), will be added once another source of definitions and examples is in place.
